data.name: Astral Enterprises
data.detailed_description:
Astral Enterprises: Industrialise space, maximise profit.

Astral Enterprises merges deep factory automation with ruthless corporate management. As CEO, you will need to fit your factories into dynamic supply and demand markets. Every factory is a spatial puzzle, every market fluctuation is an opportunity, and every choice impacts your bottom line. Do you have what it takes to please the demanding board of the Parent Company?

Design Your Perfect Factory

Every factory is built on a constrained grid where components have unique shapes and sizes. This turns industrial design into a challenging, spatial puzzle. Plan around resource nodes, inconvenient debris, and components requiring specific adjacency.

Master Complex Supply Chains

Transform raw asteroid ore into high-tech circuits. Each component offers multiple production methods, creating a deep web of strategic trade-offs. Will you choose a cheap method that only requires basic Operators, or an advanced process that produces more but demands expensive Specialists and a massive power grid?

 

Drive Corporate Innovation

Funnel profits into R&D to overhaul your production capabilities. Unlock hyper-efficient manufacturing methods, automate tedious logistical bottlenecks, and aggressively optimise your corporate margins.

Dominate the Economy & Workforce

Every sector houses a local population waiting to be mobilised. Supply citizens with refined consumer goods to grow the workforce from simple manual laborers into highly educated specialists. Deploy them into advanced facilities to maximise industrial efficiency.

 

Build your Megaproject

True success demands an audacious vanity project. Boost the Parent Company’s interstellar reputation by constructing colossal megaprojects. Just manage your resource drain carefully, as syphoning an entire sector's resources to fund a vanity build can trigger catastrophic local collapse.

For the Player Who Loves to Optimise

  • If you love the challenge of building a perfect, self-sustaining machine...

  • If you thrive on mastering complex economic systems and logistics...

  • If you believe the solution to any problem is a better-designed factory...

then Astral Enterprises is built for you. Wishlist today and build your legacy among the stars.

data.short_description: As CEO, build a ruthless corporate empire! Solve spatial factory puzzles, master complex supply chains, and manipulate dynamic markets to maximise profit. Mobilise local workforces, fund high-tech R&D, and construct colossal megaprojects to satisfy your demanding Parent Company.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 530 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Big Sur (11.0) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 @ 2.0GHz or Apple M1
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics or Apple M1 integrated GPU (7-core)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Latest version of macOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 @ 2.5GHz or Apple M1 / M2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5300M or Apple M1 / M2 integrated GPU (8-core or better)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD Graphics 530 or better) - Vulkan support recommended
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
